layers.observed: cyan dots: automatically located edge points near manually seeded boundaries
layers.fitted: yellow lines: robust line fits through the observed edge points
layers.inferred: red diamonds (labels end with *): corners computed geometrically (a corner outside a camera's frame is not drawn)
layers.matches: green: sample of cross-view SIFT matches between the two left-camera placements

note: Grayscale frames undistorted with the Recipe A intrinsics, downscaled to 480 px per panel; derived from the original videos, which are not modified.
